parse.title: Pandemonium/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
===Salvaging===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Will]] or [[Anne]] at the south docks of [[Port Sarim]] {{Chat option|1 Yes|1 I guess I'm ready...}} to accept their shipwreck salvaging job.
*''Navigate'' the helm to take control of the ship.
*Navigate south through the [[Bay of Sarim]] until you reach east of the [[Karamja Shipyard]].
**Click the minimap or water to set your heading in that direction.
**Click to ''trim'' the sails when a gust of wind arises for a speed boost.
*''Un-set'' the sails when Will says you have arrived.
*''Deploy'' the [[Salvaging hook (Pandemonium quest)|salvaging hook]], after which you will be pushed overboard.
}}

===Facilities===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [['Squawking' Steve Beanie]] at the [[The Pandemonium (Pub)|Pandemonium Pub]].
*Talk to [[Ribs (The Pandemonium)|Ribs]] just to the north to discuss the map. {{Chat option|Any}}
*Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie again. {{Chat option|2 About Will and Anne...|2 Do you have any idea where Will and Anne might have gone?}}
*Head east to the docks and talk to [[Junior Jim]] to get a [[raft]] in exchange for the salvaged [[old cup]]. He will take you to the shipyard.
**If needed, take a [[hammer]] and [[saw]] from the crates just to the south.
*''Board'' the gangplank to your raft and ''build'' a cargo hold in the [[facility hotspot]].
*''Disembark'' the gangplank and talk to Junior Jim again to return to the Pandemonium and receive a [[Captain's log]].
}}

===Cargo courier===
{{Needed|Free hands to carry cargo (no weapons equipped).}}
{{Checklist|
*''Board'' the gangplank to the north-east.
*Navigate north through [[Mudskipper Sound]] and the [[Bay of Sarim]] until you reach Port Sarim.
**Optionally use the buoy to dock your raft, then ''disembark'' the gangplank.
*Take cargo from the [[ledger table]] near the docks and board the gangplank again.
**Open the basic cargo hold to store the cargo.
*Navigate back to the docks at the Pandemonium.
**Open the basic cargo hold and withdraw the cargo.
*''Disembark'' the gangplank and deposit the cargo at the ledger table.
*Talk to Junior Jim to let him know you delivered his cargo.
*Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie in the pub for an update on Will and Anne.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
